data.gender_notes: Aramish is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Means exalted or noble in Arabic. Derived from the Arabic root 'R-M-S' which means to be exalted or to rise high. This name is often given to boys who are expected to rise above their circumstances and excel in their endeavors. The name Aramish carries the meaning “Exalted, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aramish usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual journey of a person towards self-realization and enlightenment. It is a name that inspires one to strive for greatness and to seek knowledge and wisdom. It is also believed to bring blessings and good fortune to the bearer.
data.etymology: Aramish belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aramish total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: ارمیش

in_hindi.name: अरमीश

in_pashto.name: ارمیش
